title: Approving or scheduling a campaign locks its exact content and audience, and the send refuses anything that changed

source.ref: Contact, funnel and tracking audit 2026-11-19 (project thread: Plan a permission-first contact system, report https://claude.ai/artifact/3sCikNdCHC9khmwCJbubfk)

detail:
Wave 2 of the permission-first contact plan, building on EMAIL-081 (#5379: an edit puts a scheduled email back to draft). The server-side reset depends on every edit path calling it; a fingerprint makes the send itself the guard. Work: on approve or schedule, store a hash of subject, body, audience definition and links (approval_fingerprint); sendCampaignNow and the cron recompute it and refuse, leaving the campaign in draft, when it differs. Needs a migration. Filed 2026-11-20 by the verification sweep: the plan named this id but no row existed.

campaigns.approval_fingerprint (migration 20270346510000) is stamped on approve and schedule; sendCampaignNow, which the cron calls, recomputes it before the claim and puts a changed campaign back in draft.

verify.note: Fails until a migration adds an approval fingerprint and lib/email-studio/send.ts compares it before queueing.
